overall.verdict: A genuinely differentiated wallet: the green-yours/violet-promise model is the best exposure UI in its class, and pay/receipt/activity flows are near shipping quality. But it is built for the person who designed it — amounts that don't add up, protocol jargon (capacity, frames, prepare incoming), overlapping translucent modals on irreversible actions, and truncated dense tables will lose Rosa, Lucas and half of Wei's confidence.
priority_fixes: Make every headline number reconcile: home Total/Spendable must equal the sum of their components, with an inline explanation of credit-derived spendable
Fix the dispute modal (06b): opaque surface, no overlap with live figures, typed/checked confirmation before enabling the red button
Replace jargon strings ('capacity', 'Prepare incoming account', 'frames', 'lazy entity') with plain sentences on Receive, Assets, Ownership
Show USD value next to every token amount (account lanes, swap, activity) and add frame/id to duplicate-looking activity rows
Stop truncating critical data: Desk table columns, book top rows, per-counterparty paragraph in Sovereignty need responsive priority or scroll
